data.design: Use the established Aipom silhouette and purple coloring. In a proposed bank animation, the tail hand reaches first while the body braces above it; the front hands fumble with a lid. Keep it an ordinary cheeky animal, with no new occult markings.

description:
An ordinary Normal Pokémon present in both the Listening Wood and the southern pond grass. Its dexterous handlike tail is a defining stock trait; its front hands are comparatively clumsy. Renzo already complains about Aipom stealing bait at the pond, giving the animal a place in people’s working lives. It evolves into Ambipom after a level gain while knowing Double Hit, which its native learnset offers at level 32.

Proposed bank behavior: it hangs beyond arm’s reach and uses the tail hand to test an unattended bait-box lid. Closing the lid before setting down a net prevents that opportunity; chasing it across the bank leaves the other gear unattended. It may retreat with bait and eat it in a tree rather than obligingly await a battle. The same habit gives a companion a practical care need: offer objects that can be grasped and returned, and keep hooks out of its reach.

data.description: Existing pond-grass encounters at levels 8–11. Bait theft is already mentioned in the fishermen’s dialogue; the detailed lid interaction is proposed.
Authored forest and road encounter tables, including the pond-grass table on the road map.

Renzo’s existing conversation says Aipom stole his bait and then returned for the lid. This is ordinary nuisance behavior; no theft of quest items or automatic inventory effect is established.
